name: Unnamed pathUSD Vault V2 feeding Sentora

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: owner and curator are the same single EOA - the weakest Vault V2 shape this project tracks anywhere: one key holds both roles a Vault V2 is designed to separate.
narrative.detail: Feeds directly into the Sentora pathUSD vault above (idx 10) - a weakly-governed vault sitting one hop upstream doesn’t insulate depositors in the downstream vault from this vault’s own risk.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (0 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# owner() on the contract: the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.tempo.xyz -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x83a1491f3e7f8daab8f787a631334b9ca7a87023","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x29a75db"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.tempo.xyz -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (0 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.tempo.xyz -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","0x29a75db"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 43677138 and 43677147 of the chain

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key

independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key, 0 transactions sent; delay: none
